figures.caption: Five designs, the same facts: Premiere, Universe, The Studio, The Proposal, On Tour, and the picker.
From a request to five designs in under an hour: the factory, the first version, five design agents, a handover.
The film's credits and its making: 2,300 words of direction, 43 images, 16 motion clips, 21 exports, one film.
All five designs on a phone, each rebuilt for a small screen.
His 17 agents three ways: a solar system in six rings, bars by group, and a mixing desk of faders.
The Studio: the film on a monitor, liner notes, the session as a DAW arrangement, and a studio wall of photos.
On Tour: a gig poster, the stage in photos, the crew as backstage passes, and the rig: UNIVERSO, X-Ray, Gravity.
The work: the X-Ray and Gravity as worlds, the portfolio of what he built, and a case study in one format.
How to hire him: services to confirm, a box office, and a studio booking, each with "ask your AI about him".
